title: CISO Conversations: Ryan Davis – The Unknown Is Where Security Meets Reality
description: This content is an interview-style article featuring Ryan Davis, a cybersecurity professional and CISO at New Charter Technologies, discussing his career journey and perspectives on cybersecurity leadership. The article highlights his early hacking experiences, career progression, and views on the evolving role of CISOs, including concerns about emerging threats like shadow AI. It does not describe a specific security vulnerability or active threat.
